name: Stories
description: The team's published posts and the model stories an admin featured, newest first, in one keyset over (at, id): a post's published_at, a story's featured_at. `kind` is all, team or model. Each row is a card -- kind, title, a 280-character excerpt, the author, when -- and a story's adds its model and class; a post opens at /blog/:slug, a story on its model page. `total` is counted on the first page only. `limit` defaults to 20 and clamps at 60 in SQL. A removed story, a story whose first text is still held, and an unpublished post are never listed.
